scoring_justification: Cannot recompute the full LCAO band structure from raw artifacts; we compare reported eigenvalues and splittings to paper‑reported reference with tolerances and also verify level ordering (structural).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference band eigenvalues at Γ and M and splittings for the Cu(001) monolayer
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported band energies for Cu(001) monolayer (Fig. 2 and discussion)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the paper's results; these are the values the reference solve.sh writes.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly the paper's own reported energies for the same monolayer, same k‑points and symmetry labels.

outputs.description: Computed d‑band and s‑band eigenvalues (in Ry) for the Cu(001) monolayer at the Γ and M points of the surface Brillouin zone, together with the energy splittings Δ(Γ25′) and Δ(Γ12) derived from the bulk Γ25′ and Γ12 parentage. Symmetry‑labelled states correspond to the orbital assignments given in the paper.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported eigenvalues and splittings to reference benchmark values (the paper‑reported Cu(001) monolayer band energies) using a result‑level comparison with appropriate absolute tolerances. No recomputation from raw wavefunctions or contour plots is performed; the checker directly reads the scalar values from this JSON file.

steps.description: Check eigenvalues and splittings against paper reference with tolerances and verify ordering.
